---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an improvement or new feature
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves

What problem does this feature solve? What use case does it address?

## Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution or implementation approach.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or features? If so, please describe them.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Implementation Ideas

If you have thoughts on how this could be implemented, share them here:
- Technical approach
- Files/components that might need changes
- Potential challenges

## Willing to Contribute?

- [ ] I would be willing to implement this feature
- [ ] I would like help implementing this feature
- [ ] I'm just suggesting this feature for consideration

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and feature requests
- [ ] This feature aligns with the repository's purpose
- [ ] I have provided sufficient detail above
